report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency degradation, but current telemetry contradicts it: gateway/order/payment/inventory metrics all show error_rate 0.0014 and p95 78ms, dependency_timeouts 0, and logs/traces are OK/200. Order shows retained heap after GC (340MB, 10 WARNs), but a single snapshot without a chronological series cannot establish a memory leak, and it does not explain the alleged latency/error alert. Insufficient evidence for any bounded candidate; handing off.
missing_evidence: Current error-rate/latency telemetry showing the alert condition; all admitted metrics show error_rate 0.0014 and p95 78ms
Chronological memory-retention series for order to establish a leak trend rather than a single retained-heap snapshot
Evidence of downstream latency or dependency timeouts (all show 0)
Deployment facts or config-change records tied to the alert window
